map.算法：地面覆盖宽度 W = 2×H×tan(FOV/2)（m，FOV 需先转弧度: Algorithm: ground coverage width W = 2 times H times tan(FOV/2) (m, FOV first to radians); effective scan bandwidth = W times (1 minus overlap rate / 100); coverage area = effective bandwidth times route length times 1000 / 1e6 (km2, route length in km); inspection time = route length / speed times 60 (min); inspection efficiency = coverage area / (time / 60) (km2/h). Overlap rate ensures adjacent strips stitch; normally 20 percent to 40 percent.

If height drops to 80 m (FOV unchanged) gives W = 112.0 m, effective bandwidth 78.4 m, coverage area 0.392 km2, efficiency 4.70 km2/h, resolution up but efficiency down 33 percent. If overlap drops to 10 percent gives effective bandwidth 151.2 m, coverage area 0.756 km2, efficiency 9.07 km2/h, but ensure no gaps in image stitching.
map.航向与旁向重叠一般取 20%~40%。地形起伏大、需要生成高精度正射影像或三维模: Course and side overlap normally 20 percent to 40 percent. Large terrain relief, or needing high-precision orthophoto or 3D model, take the upper bound; flat areas for rough patrol can take about 20 percent. Too high overlap clearly lowers efficiency; too low easily misses shots or leaves holes at stitch seams.
